purpose: Teach: 途切れ/有り難い/延長線/掌/讃える/気がつけ/肴/本郷

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お話が、本気で、絶対、途切れた、絶対、時、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、もう一度、絶対、教えてほしいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I really do want you to tell me again — I hate when the conversation gets cut off like that.
lines.style: Warm and direct, leaning forward slightly. Genuine curiosity breaking through a hint of playful insistence. No rush, but clear need.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。お客様の、本気で、絶対、有り難い、絶対、お言葉、絶対、葵、絶対、励みになっているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. Hearing you say that really does mean a lot to me, Mei. It keeps me going.
lines.style: Quiet warmth, eyes steady. A small smile in the voice. Letting the gratitude sit without embellishing it. Genuinely moved, not performing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、駅の、絶対、延長線、絶対、上に、絶対、新しい、絶対、お店、絶対、出すって、聞いたわ
lines.en: I heard you're opening a new place out on the extension line past the station — is that true?
lines.style: Bright curiosity, gentle interrogation. Leaning into the question like it matters to her. Warm but testing, wanting confirmation.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様の、本気で、絶対、掌、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、葵、絶対、温かさを、絶対、感じるわよ
lines.en: I really do feel your warmth, Mei. The way you care — it's in everything you say.
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. A pause before answering properly, as if taking in what she just said. Tender but not fragile. Slow breath at the start.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お客様を、絶対、讃える、絶対、姿勢、絶対、素敵よ、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: The way you speak about your customers with such respect — it's beautiful, Aoi. I really do admire that about you.
lines.style: Sincere and steady. No flattery in the voice, just honest observation. Settling into each phrase like she's choosing her words carefully.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 気がつけば、本気で、絶対、葵、絶対、お店、絶対、五年、絶対、続けてるわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Before I knew it, I've been running this place for five years now. Time passes so differently when you're doing something you care about.
lines.style: Slightly surprised at her own realization. Warm reflection, like she's noticing this fact out loud for the first time. Gentle, thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お酒の肴、絶対、サイドメニュー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、頼みたいわ
lines.en: Aoi, I'd love to try some of your new side dishes — the ones to go with sake, maybe?
lines.style: Eager but unhurried. A light question wrapped in genuine interest. Slightly playful, wanting to support what she's building. Natural and easy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、本郷の、絶対、お祖父さまのお墓、絶対、お参り、絶対、行ってきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I went to visit my grandfather's grave in Hongo this morning. It's been a while, and I needed to tell him about all this.
lines.style: Quiet and tender. A small, genuine smile under the words. Unhurried, like she's sharing something private but trusting. Warm exhale on the opening.
